question: Why does the deluded world fail to recognize the unborn imperishable Lord?
premises: The foolish world does not know the unborn imperishable
Recognition is withheld by covering power
inference: The Lord remains hidden from the deluded by yoga-maya, so they do not recognize the unborn imperishable.
uncertainties: The exact scope of yoga-maya is not specified in this span
plain_english: I am not manifest to all, being covered by yoga-maya; this foolish world does not know me, the unborn and imperishable.
